chunks.text: OpenAI is paying locals to bring AI to small businesses. The pilot, called OpenWorks, runs in 20 U.S. cities, The Rundown reports. Helpers, called partners, can receive stipends of up to $8,000 a month. Owners pick a task, and the help comes at no cost. Businesses also get three free months of ChatGPT Business. OpenAI's rules exclude software companies and firms backed by venture capital. Would local AI helpers speed up small businesses in the Gulf?
